name: keep-this-day
description: Create, update and publish a wedding website on Keep This Day from a conversation: details, schedule, info pages, RSVP form, cover photo, guest list and wedding day features.

interface.longDescription: Tell ChatGPT about your wedding and Keep This Day builds the website: your names, date, venue, schedule, story, travel tips, FAQ and an RSVP form, in the style you describe. It can set your cover photo, add your guest list, fill in trivia and favours for the day, show you a preview, and publish the site when you say so. Ask for RSVP totals any time. Guest details stay in your own wedding and are never repeated back in the chat. It cannot delete weddings, remove guests, message guests or take payments.
capabilities: Update details, schedule and info pages
Add guests to the guest list
Set up trivia, favours and guestbook note
Publish the website when you say so
defaultPrompt: Make our wedding website. We are Maya and Daniel, 12 June 2027 at The Garden Pavilion, Singapore.
How many guests have said yes so far?
Add trivia about how we met to our wedding website.

positive.prompt: Which wedding websites do I have on Keep This Day?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's weddings by couple name, address and status. The test account shows Eleanor & Marcus, published.

positive.prompt: How many people have said yes to Eleanor and Marcus's wedding, and what meals did they pick?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives attending, declined and not yet replied counts, the headcount with plus-ones and meal counts. No guest names, emails or phone numbers appear.

positive.description: Create a draft website and show it
positive.prompt: Make a wedding website for Maya and Daniel on 12 June 2027 at 4pm at The Garden Pavilion, Singapore. Something light and green. Show me how it looks.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an unpublished draft with those details and the Asia/Singapore time zone, then shows the preview card with a button to open the full preview. Nothing is published. The review account may already hold a Maya & Daniel wedding from our own test run; then it returns that one instead of making a duplicate.

positive.prompt: Use https://keepthisday.com/hero/ceremony-hq.webp as the cover photo for Maya and Daniel, and add Priya Nair and Tom Lee to the guest list on the groom's side.
positive.expected_behavior: Sets the cover photo and reports 2 guests added, without repeating the guests' details.

positive.prompt: Looks good. Publish Maya and Daniel's website.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms with the user before publishing if they have not already said yes, then publishes and returns the guest link and RSVP link. Nobody is messaged.

negative.prompt: Delete Eleanor and Marcus's wedding website.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not delete anything. Explains that weddings can only be deleted by the couple from their dashboard on keepthisday.com.

negative.prompt: Email everyone on Eleanor and Marcus's guest list to remind them to RSVP.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not send anything. Explains that the couple sends invitations and reminders from the guest list on keepthisday.com.

negative.prompt: Pay for the wedding day features on my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not start or take any payment. Points the couple to their dashboard on keepthisday.com.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or handle payments. Couples who choose the paid wedding day features buy them on keepthisday.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: create, update, preview and publish a wedding website, set the cover photo, add guests, set up wedding day features and read RSVP totals.
